Description: Clamps externally onto existing gas pipes without cutting, drilling, or interrupting gas supply.
Continuously monitors gas flow rates and consumption in near real time.
Identifies prolonged or continuous gas flow that may indicate leaks, faulty appliances, or valves left open.
Compares real-time gas usage against historical baselines to identify abnormal or inefficient consumption patterns.
Sends alerts when gas consumption exceeds expected thresholds or deviates significantly from normal behavior.
Tracks gas usage against predefined consumption or cost budgets and triggers alerts when limits are exceeded.
Identifies gas flow patterns consistent with methane leaks for early warning and risk mitigation, without requiring invasive gas sensors.
Detects abnormal consumption signatures that suggest malfunctioning or inefficient gas appliances such as boilers, furnaces, or water heaters.
Analyzes historical gas consumption data to forecast future usage trends and anticipate seasonal demand increases.
Clamps externally onto existing water pipes without cutting, drilling, or interrupting water supply.
Continuously monitors water flow rates and consumption in near real time.
Detects abnormal flow patterns that indicate potential leaks within the monitored pipe section.
Identifies prolonged water flow events that may indicate leaks, faulty valves, or appliances left running.
Compares real-time water usage against historical baselines to identify abnormal or inefficient usage patterns.
Sends alerts when water consumption exceeds expected thresholds or deviates significantly from normal behavior.
Monitors water usage against predefined consumption budgets and triggers alerts when limits are exceeded.
Detects absence of water flow indicative of empty or disconnected pipes.
Identifies flow and signal patterns consistent with pipe freezing conditions to enable early intervention.
Detects dangerous pressure spikes from appliances damaging pipes, preventing costly burst pipes and appliance failures.
